svg.title: Figure 5-1. Safety goals, FSRs and allocation (WP-C-04 §3, §5, §9)
svg.desc: Matrix of the WP-C-04 functional safety requirements grouped by safety goal. For each goal: ASIL, safe state and preliminary FTTI. For each FSR: its ASIL, the other goals it serves in the §9 trace, and a marker in the column of each element it is allocated to (E-03 envelope, E-05 harness relay, E-01 SoC software, E-01/DM, E-01/HMI, E-02, and the external measures EXT-EPS, EXT-PCM, EXT-CLU). SG-01: 14 FSRs. SG-02: 11 FSRs. SG-03: 6 FSRs. SG-04: 6 FSRs. SG-05: 7 FSRs. SG-06: 5 FSRs. SG-07: 5 FSRs.
svg.text: Figure 5-1 · Safety goals, functional safety requirements and allocation
7 safety goals (§3) → 54 FSRs (§5) → allocated elements (§5 Alloc), with the §9 trace
No uncontrollable lateral motion, no steering
Safe state: LKA torque 0, steer request cleared
No loss/degradation of lateral control without
No deceleration beyond what following traffic
Safe state: Inactive (no ACC command) with bounded
Release on driver brake, cancel, steering
No loss of longitudinal deceleration without
as ref.: allocation as in the FSRs it references
No suppression, delay or alteration of stock
Safe state: Camera PCS messages forwarded; relay
released if forwarding cannot be guaranteed

Also serves: the other safety goals the §9 trace marks for the FSR (number = SG-0n). Roles stated in the Alloc column (detection, alert, backstop, ...) are not drawn; see §5 and the allocation summary in §10.
All FSRs have status Proposed; a dot shows allocation, not implementation. SG-01 FSRs carry ASIL C until the controllability evidence of §4.2 exists. FTTIs are preliminary (§8, WP-S-04).
Marker = FSR allocated to that element; colour = FSR ASIL
